<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/5.15.4/css/all.min.css"><script type="application/ld+json">{"@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "AutomotiveBusiness", "additionalType": "https://schema.org/TowingService", "name": "AAD Transport & Recovery", "url": "https://maroon-raven-160825.hostingersite.com/", "telephone": "+447771004242", "email": "general@aadtransportrecovery.co.uk", "image": "https://maroon-raven-160825.hostingersite.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/A.A.D-Logo-TP.webp", "address": {"@type": "PostalAddress", "streetAddress": "Walsall Rd", "addressLocality": "Birmingham", "addressRegion": "West Midlands", "postalCode": "B42 1TQ", "addressCountry": "GB"}, "openingHoursSpecification": {"@type": "OpeningHoursSpecification", "dayOfWeek": ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday", "Sunday"], "opens": "00:00", "closes": "23:59"}, "areaServed": ["Birmingham", "West Midlands", "Erdington", "Perry Barr", "Aston", "Sutton Coldfield", "Solihull", "West Bromwich", "Walsall", "Dudley"]}</script><link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Outfit:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=Figtree:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap"><style>:root{--x-navy:#011D5E;--x-navy-2:#010F35;--x-orange:#FE6402;--x-orange-2:#E55800;--x-text:#4B546E;--x-cream:#FAF9F5;--x-light:#F4F6FA;--x-line:#E3E8F2;--x-r:18px;--x-sh:0 10px 30px -12px rgba(1,29,94,.18);--x-sh-lg:0 30px 60px -20px rgba(1,29,94,.35);--x-ease:cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}body{background:#fff}
.x-root{--padding-top:0;--padding-bottom:0;font-family:"Figtree",sans-serif;color:var(--x-text);overflow-x:clip}
.x-root .e-con{--padding-left:0;--padding-right:0}
.x-root .e-con-boxed>.e-con-inner{max-width:1440px;padding-left:20px;padding-right:20px}
.x-h .elementor-heading-title{font-family:"Outfit",sans-serif;color:var(--x-navy);letter-spacing:-.02em}
.x-t p:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
/* reveal */
.x-js .rv{opacity:0;transform:translateY(28px);transition:opacity .8s var(--x-ease),transform .8s var(--x-ease)}
.x-js .rv.rv-left{transform:translateX(-40px)}.x-js .rv.rv-right{transform:translateX(40px)}
.x-js .rv.is-in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.rv-d1{transition-delay:.08s!important}.rv-d2{transition-delay:.16s!important}.rv-d3{transition-delay:.24s!important}
body.elementor-editor-active .rv{opacity:1!important;transform:none!important}
/* buttons */
.x-btn .elementor-button,.x-link .elementor-button{font-family:"Outfit",sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:16px;border-radius:999px;padding:16px 28px;background:var(--x-orange);color:#fff;border:2px solid var(--x-orange);box-shadow:0 12px 24px -10px rgba(254,100,2,.6);transition:transform .25s var(--x-ease),box-shadow .25s,background .25s,color .25s}
.x-btn .elementor-button:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);background:var(--x-orange-2);border-color:var(--x-orange-2);box-shadow:0 18px 30px -12px rgba(254,100,2,.7);color:#fff}
.x-btn-sm .elementor-button{padding:12px 22px;font-size:15px}
.x-btn-ghost .elementor-button{background:transparent;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);box-shadow:none;color:#fff}
.x-btn-ghost .elementor-button:hover{background:#fff;color:var(--x-navy);border-color:#fff}
.x-btn-white .elementor-button{background:#fff;color:var(--x-orange);border-color:#fff}
.x-btn-white .elementor-button:hover{background:var(--x-navy);border-color:var(--x-navy);color:#fff}
.x-btn-pulse .elementor-button{animation:xpulse 2.4s infinite}
@keyframes xpulse{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(254,100,2,.55)}70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 16px rgba(254,100,2,0)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(254,100,2,0)}}
.x-link .elementor-button{background:none;border:0;box-shadow:none;padding:0;color:var(--x-orange);font-size:15px}
.x-link .elementor-button:after{content:"→";margin-left:8px;display:inline-block;transition:transform .25s}
.x-link .elementor-button:hover:after{transform:translateX(5px)}
.x-btnrow{gap:14px}
/* header */
.x-header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:999;transition:box-shadow .3s}
.x-topbar{background:var(--x-navy-2);padding:8px 0;font-size:14px}
.x-topbar .elementor-icon-list-text{color:#C9D3EC;font-weight:500}
.x-topbar .x-topphone .elementor-icon-list-text{color:#fff;font-weight:600}
.x-topbar i{color:var(--x-orange)!important}
.x-live i{font-size:8px!important;animation:xblink 1.6s infinite}
@keyframes xblink{50%{opacity:.25}}
.x-mainbar{background:rgba(255,255,255,.92);backdrop-filter:saturate(1.6) blur(14px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:saturate(1.6) blur(14px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--x-line);transition:padding .3s}
.x-mainbar>.e-con-inner{padding-top:14px!important;padding-bottom:14px!important;transition:padding .3s;gap:20px}
.x-header.is-scrolled{box-shadow:var(--x-sh)}
.x-header.is-scrolled .x-mainbar>.e-con-inner{padding-top:8px!important;padding-bottom:8px!important}
.x-logo img{max-width:150px;transition:max-width .3s}.x-header.is-scrolled .x-logo img{max-width:120px}
.x-nav{flex:1}.x-nav .elementor-nav-menu--main .elementor-item{font-family:"Figtree";font-weight:600;font-size:15px;padding:10px 16px}
.x-nav .elementor-nav-menu--dropdown:not(.elementor-nav-menu--dropdown-tablet) , .x-nav .sub-menu{border-radius:14px;box-shadow:var(--x-sh-lg);overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--x-line)}
.x-nav .elementor-nav-menu--main .sub-menu{animation:xdrop .25s var(--x-ease)}
@keyframes xdrop{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px)}}
.x-nav .elementor-nav-menu--dropdown a{font-weight:500;padding:12px 20px!important}
/* hero */
.x-hero{position:relative;padding:110px 0 130px!important;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate}
.x-hero:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;background:linear-gradient(105deg,rgba(1,15,53,.96) 0%,rgba(1,29,94,.88) 48%,rgba(1,29,94,.45) 100%)}
.x-hero:after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-180px;top:-180px;width:520px;height:520px;border-radius:50%;z-index:-1;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(254,100,2,.35),transparent 65%);animation:xfloat 9s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes xfloat{50%{transform:translate(-40px,40px)}}
.x-hero>.e-con-inner{gap:56px;align-items:center}
.x-hero-copy{flex:1 1 56%;gap:22px}
.x-badge p{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);color:#fff;border-radius:999px;padding:8px 16px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.02em;margin:0}
.x-dot{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:#2BD576;box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(43,213,118,.7);animation:xping 1.8s infinite}
@keyframes xping{70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 10px rgba(43,213,118,0)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(43,213,118,0)}}
.x-hero-title .elementor-heading-title{color:#fff;font-size:clamp(34px,4.4vw,58px);font-weight:800;line-height:1.08}
.x-hero-lead{color:#D5DCEE;font-size:18px;line-height:1.7;max-width:620px}
.x-chips{gap:12px;margin-top:8px}
.x-chip{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);border-radius:14px;padding:12px 16px;width:auto!important;transition:transform .3s,background .3s}
.x-chip:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);background:rgba(255,255,255,.14)}
.x-chip .elementor-icon-box-wrapper{gap:12px;align-items:center;display:flex}.x-chip .elementor-icon-box-icon{margin:0!important}
.x-chip .elementor-icon{font-size:20px;color:var(--x-orange)}
.x-chip .elementor-icon-box-title{color:#fff;font-family:"Outfit";font-weight:700;font-size:15px;margin:0}
.x-chip .elementor-icon-box-description{color:#AEB9D6;font-size:13px;margin:0}
.x-hero-card{flex:1 1 40%;max-width:470px;background:#fff;border-radius:24px;padding:34px!important;box-shadow:var(--x-sh-lg);position:relative;gap:6px;scroll-margin-top:140px}
.x-hero-card:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0 0 auto 0;height:6px;border-radius:24px 24px 0 0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--x-orange),#FF9A4D)}
.x-card-title p{font-family:"Outfit";font-size:26px;color:var(--x-navy);margin:0}
.x-card-sub{font-size:15px;margin-bottom:12px}
.x-form .elementor-field-group>label{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--x-navy)}
.x-form .elementor-field-textual,.x-form select{border:1.5px solid var(--x-line)!important;border-radius:12px!important;background:var(--x-light)!important;padding:12px 14px!important;font-size:15px!important;transition:border-color .2s,box-shadow .2s,background .2s}
.x-form .elementor-field-textual:focus,.x-form select:focus{border-color:var(--x-orange)!important;background:#fff!important;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(254,100,2,.15)!important;outline:0}
.x-form textarea{min-height:96px}
.x-form .elementor-button{width:100%;border-radius:999px;background:var(--x-orange)!important;font-family:"Outfit";font-weight:700;font-size:16px;padding:16px;transition:transform .25s,background .25s}
.x-form .elementor-button:hover{background:var(--x-orange-2)!important;transform:translateY(-2px)}
/* sections */
.x-sec{padding:100px 0!important}.x-sec>.e-con-inner{gap:18px}
.x-eyebrow p{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-family:"Outfit";font-weight:700;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--x-orange);margin:0}
.x-eyebrow p:before{content:"";width:28px;height:2px;background:var(--x-orange)}
.x-title .elementor-heading-title{font-size:clamp(28px,3vw,44px);font-weight:800;line-height:1.15}
.x-lead{font-size:17px;line-height:1.75;max-width:760px;margin-bottom:24px}
.x-body{font-size:16px;line-height:1.8}
.x-sec-svc>.e-con-inner,.x-sec-how>.e-con-inner{align-items:center;text-align:center}
.x-sec-svc .x-lead,.x-sec-how .x-lead{margin-inline:auto}
.x-sec-glance{padding:0!important;margin-top:-60px!important;position:relative;z-index:3}
.x-glance{background:#fff;border-radius:var(--x-r);box-shadow:var(--x-sh-lg);padding:34px 40px!important;gap:32px;align-items:center;border-left:6px solid var(--x-orange)}
.x-glance .x-eyebrow{flex:0 0 auto}.x-glance-text{font-size:17px;line-height:1.75;color:var(--x-navy)}
.x-glance-text strong{color:var(--x-orange)!important;white-space:nowrap}
.x-sec-split{padding:80px 0!important}
.x-split{gap:64px;align-items:center}.x-split-rev{flex-direction:row-reverse!important}
.x-split>.e-con{flex:1 1 50%}
.x-media-wrap{position:relative}
.x-media-wrap:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:24px -24px -24px 24px;border-radius:24px;background:var(--x-light);border:2px dashed rgba(254,100,2,.35);z-index:-1}
.x-split-rev .x-media-wrap:before{inset:24px 24px -24px -24px}
.x-media img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:4/3.4;object-fit:cover;border-radius:24px;box-shadow:var(--x-sh-lg)}
.x-split-copy{gap:18px}.x-split-copy strong{color:var(--x-navy)}
.x-split-copy .x-btn{margin-top:8px}
.x-sec-svc{background:var(--x-light)}
.x-grid{gap:26px;width:100%;margin-top:20px}
.x-grid-3>.e-con{flex:0 0 calc((100% - 52px)/3)}
.x-grid-4>.elementor-element{flex:0 0 calc((100% - 78px)/4);width:auto}
.x-scard{background:#fff;border-radius:var(--x-r);overflow:hidden;text-align:left;box-shadow:0 2px 0 var(--x-line);transition:transform .45s var(--x-ease),box-shadow .45s}
.x-scard:hover{transform:translateY(-8px);box-shadow:var(--x-sh-lg)}
.x-scard-img{overflow:hidden;position:relative}
.x-scard-img img{width:100%;height:220px;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .8s var(--x-ease)}
.x-scard:hover .x-scard-img img{transform:scale(1.08)}
.x-scard-body{padding:26px!important;gap:10px;flex:1}
.x-scard-title .elementor-heading-title{font-size:21px;font-weight:700}
.x-scard-text{font-size:15px;line-height:1.7;flex:1}
.x-scard-text p{display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:4;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden}
.x-reasons{gap:60px;align-items:flex-start}.x-reasons>.e-con{flex:1 1 50%}
.x-reasons-intro{gap:18px;position:sticky;top:140px}
.x-note{background:#FFF4EC;border-radius:14px;padding:18px 22px;border-left:4px solid var(--x-orange);color:var(--x-navy)}
.x-reasons-lists{gap:0;flex-direction:column!important;background:var(--x-navy);border-radius:24px;padding:36px!important;box-shadow:var(--x-sh-lg)}
.x-checks ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.x-checks li{position:relative;padding:14px 0 14px 40px;color:#E4E9F6;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);font-size:16px}
.x-checks li:before{content:"✓";position:absolute;left:0;top:13px;width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--x-orange);color:#fff;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;display:grid;place-items:center}
.x-checks li span{font-weight:400!important}
.x-dark{background:radial-gradient(1200px 500px at 90% -10%,rgba(254,100,2,.18),transparent 60%),linear-gradient(180deg,var(--x-navy),var(--x-navy-2))}
.x-dark .x-sec>.e-con-inner{align-items:center;text-align:center}
.x-dark .x-title .elementor-heading-title{color:#fff}.x-dark .x-lead{color:#B9C3DD;margin-inline:auto}
.x-wcard{background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-radius:var(--x-r);padding:30px 24px;transition:transform .4s var(--x-ease),background .4s,border-color .4s}
.x-wcard:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);background:rgba(255,255,255,.09);border-color:rgba(254,100,2,.5)}
.x-wcard .elementor-icon{width:60px;height:60px;display:grid!important;place-items:center;border-radius:16px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--x-orange),#FF9A4D);color:#fff;font-size:24px;transition:transform .4s var(--x-ease)}
.x-wcard .elementor-icon svg{fill:#fff;width:24px}
.x-wcard:hover .elementor-icon{transform:rotate(-8deg) scale(1.08)}
.x-wcard .elementor-icon-box-title{color:#fff;font-family:"Outfit";font-size:19px;font-weight:700;margin:18px 0 8px}
.x-wcard .elementor-icon-box-description{color:#AEB9D6;font-size:15px;line-height:1.65}
.x-areas{gap:10px;margin-top:6px}
.x-area .elementor-heading-title{font-family:"Figtree"!important;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;background:var(--x-light);border:1px solid var(--x-line);color:var(--x-navy);border-radius:999px;padding:9px 16px 9px 34px;position:relative;transition:all .25s;letter-spacing:0}
.x-area .elementor-heading-title:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:15px;top:50%;width:8px;height:8px;margin-top:-4px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--x-orange)}
.x-area:hover .elementor-heading-title{background:var(--x-navy);color:#fff;transform:translateY(-2px)}
.x-map iframe{border-radius:24px;height:460px!important;box-shadow:var(--x-sh-lg);filter:saturate(.9)}
.x-map-wrap{width:100%}
.x-sec-how{background:var(--x-cream)}
.x-steps{gap:24px;width:100%;margin-top:24px;position:relative;counter-reset:s}
.x-steps:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:12%;right:12%;top:40px;border-top:2px dashed rgba(254,100,2,.4)}
.x-step{flex:1 1 0;background:#fff;border-radius:var(--x-r);padding:0 24px 30px!important;align-items:center;text-align:center;gap:10px;box-shadow:var(--x-sh);position:relative;margin-top:40px;transition:transform .4s var(--x-ease)}
.x-step:hover{transform:translateY(-6px)}
.x-step-n .elementor-heading-title{width:80px;height:80px;margin:-40px auto 8px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--x-navy);color:#fff;font-size:26px;font-weight:800;border:6px solid var(--x-cream);transition:background .3s}
.x-step:hover .x-step-n .elementor-heading-title{background:var(--x-orange)}
.x-step-t .elementor-heading-title{font-size:19px;font-weight:700}
.x-step-d{font-size:15px;line-height:1.7}
.x-split-faq{align-items:flex-start}.x-split-faq>.x-faq-intro{flex:0 1 38%;gap:18px;position:sticky;top:140px}.x-split-faq>.x-faq-wrap{flex:1 1 62%}
.x-faq .elementor-accordion-item{border:1px solid var(--x-line)!important;border-radius:16px;margin-bottom:14px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff;transition:box-shadow .3s,border-color .3s}
.x-faq .elementor-accordion-item:hover{box-shadow:var(--x-sh)}
.x-faq .elementor-tab-title{padding:20px 24px!important;font-family:"Outfit";font-weight:700;font-size:17px;border:0!important}
.x-faq .elementor-tab-title a{color:var(--x-navy)!important}
.x-faq .elementor-tab-title.elementor-active{background:var(--x-navy)}
.x-faq .elementor-tab-title.elementor-active a,.x-faq .elementor-tab-title.elementor-active .elementor-accordion-icon{color:#fff!important}
.x-faq .elementor-accordion-icon{color:var(--x-orange)!important}
.x-faq .elementor-tab-content{padding:20px 24px!important;border:0!important;line-height:1.75;font-size:15.5px}
.x-sec-cta{padding-top:0!important}
.x-cta{background:linear-gradient(120deg,var(--x-orange),#FF8A33);border-radius:28px;padding:56px 60px!important;gap:30px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;position:relative;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 30px 60px -25px rgba(254,100,2,.6)}
.x-cta:after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-100px;bottom:-140px;width:360px;height:360px;border-radius:50%;border:50px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
.x-cta-copy{flex:1 1 60%;gap:12px;position:relative;z-index:1}.x-cta .x-btnrow{position:relative;z-index:1}
.x-cta-title .elementor-heading-title{color:#fff;font-family:"Outfit";font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(26px,3vw,40px)}
.x-cta-text{color:#FFF1E6;font-size:17px}
/* footer */
.x-footer{background:var(--x-navy-2);color:#7E8BB0;position:relative}
.x-footer:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0 0 auto;height:4px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--x-orange),transparent)}
.x-fgrid{padding:80px 0 50px!important}.x-fgrid>.e-con-inner{gap:40px;flex-direction:row;flex-wrap:wrap}
.x-fcol{flex:1 1 0;gap:16px}.x-fcol-wide{flex:1.4 1 0}
.x-fabout{font-size:15px;line-height:1.8;color:#8C99BF}
.x-fhead .elementor-heading-title{color:#fff;font-family:"Outfit";font-weight:700;font-size:16px;letter-spacing:.04em}
.x-flinks .elementor-icon-list-item{padding:6px 0!important}
.x-flinks .elementor-icon-list-text{color:#8C99BF;font-size:15px;transition:color .2s,padding .2s}
.x-flinks a:hover .elementor-icon-list-text{color:var(--x-orange);padding-left:6px}
.x-fcontact i{color:var(--x-orange)!important;width:16px}
.x-fbottom{border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);padding:22px 0!important}
.x-fcopy{font-size:14px;color:#6D7AA0;text-align:center;width:100%}
.x-float-call{position:fixed;right:20px;bottom:20px;z-index:998;display:none;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:var(--x-orange);color:#fff!important;font-family:"Outfit";font-weight:700;padding:14px 20px;border-radius:999px;box-shadow:0 14px 30px -10px rgba(254,100,2,.8);animation:xpulse 2.4s infinite;text-decoration:none}
/* responsive */
@media(max-width:1024px){
.x-hero>.e-con-inner,.x-split,.x-reasons,.x-split-faq{flex-direction:column!important}
.x-hero-card{max-width:100%;width:100%}.x-hero{padding:80px 0 110px!important}
.x-split>.e-con,.x-reasons>.e-con{width:100%}
.x-reasons-intro,.x-split-faq>.x-faq-intro{position:static}
.x-grid-3>.e-con{flex-basis:calc((100% - 26px)/2)}.x-grid-4>.elementor-element{flex-basis:calc((100% - 26px)/2)}
.x-steps{flex-wrap:wrap}.x-steps:before{display:none}.x-step{flex:1 1 calc(50% - 12px)}
.x-hdr-cta{display:none}.x-float-call{display:inline-flex}
.x-nav .elementor-menu-toggle{background:var(--x-light);border-radius:12px;padding:10px}
.x-nav .elementor-nav-menu--dropdown{border-radius:16px;box-shadow:var(--x-sh-lg);margin-top:12px;overflow:hidden}
}
@media(max-width:767px){
.x-sec{padding:64px 0!important}.x-sec-split{padding:48px 0!important}
.x-topbar .x-live{display:none}.x-topbar>.e-con-inner{justify-content:center!important}
.x-hero-lead{font-size:16px}.x-hero-card{padding:24px!important}
.x-btnrow>.elementor-element,.x-btnrow .elementor-button{width:100%}
.x-glance{flex-direction:column!important;padding:26px!important;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start}
.x-grid-3>.e-con,.x-grid-4>.elementor-element,.x-step{flex-basis:100%}
.x-reasons-lists{padding:24px!important}
.x-media-wrap:before{display:none}
.x-cta{padding:36px 24px!important;text-align:center}

settings.editor: AT A GLANCE

AAD Transport & Recovery provides 24/7 breakdown recovery in Birmingham, including emergency breakdown recovery, car recovery, accident recovery, flatbed and wheel-lift towing, and long-distance vehicle transport. Whatever's happened to your vehicle, call 07771 004242 for fast, professional roadside assistance anywhere in Birmingham and the West Midlands.

A breakdown never happens at a convenient time. Whether your car has cut out on the motorway during rush hour, refused to start outside your house on a Sunday morning, or left you stranded in a supermarket car park late at night, AAD Transport & Recovery is available around the clock to help.

Our team responds quickly, communicates clearly, and handles every vehicle with care from the moment we arrive to the moment it's safely delivered to its destination.

We cover breakdowns anywhere in Birmingham, including residential streets, workplaces, retail car parks, and busy routes such as the M6, M5, M42 and A38. If you're unsure whether your car is safe to continue driving, call us and we'll advise the safest next step.

settings.title: Car Recovery Birmingham You Can Rely On

settings.editor:
When you search for car recovery in Birmingham, you want a company that turns up quickly, treats your vehicle properly, and doesn't leave you guessing about cost or timing. AAD Transport & Recovery has built its reputation on exactly that.

We use the right vehicle for the job every time: wheel-lift recovery for quick, local jobs, and flatbed recovery for vehicles that need to be transported without touching the road, such as those with steering, suspension or transmission damage.

From the first phone call, we aim to give you a clear idea of arrival time, cost, and what happens next, so you're never left standing at the roadside wondering what's going on.
WHAT WE DO

Whatever's happened to your vehicle, we provide breakdown recovery and roadside assistance to match. From a flat tyre outside your house to a motorway breakdown or long-distance transport, our Birmingham team handles it all with care and professionalism.

AAD Transport & Recovery offers 24/7 emergency breakdown recovery across Birmingham, responding quickly whether your engine's cut out, your car won't start, or a warning light has you worried. We cover residential streets, workplaces, car parks, and major roads like the M6, M5, M42 and A38 — just call with your location and we'll be on our way.

link.custom_attributes: aria-label|Learn more about Emergency Breakdown Recovery

settings.editor: Need a vehicle towed across Birmingham? Our towing service handles cars, vans and small commercial vehicles, moving them safely to a garage, your home, or wherever you need. We use the right equipment for the job — wheel-lift for quick local jobs, flatbed for vehicles that shouldn't be dragged — so your car arrives in the same condition it left in.

Flatbed recovery is the safest way to move a vehicle that can't or shouldn't be driven whether it's a low-clearance car, a vehicle with steering or transmission damage, or one that's been in an accident. We load, secure, and transport your car without it touching the ground, avoiding further damage on the journey.

Being involved in an accident is stressful enough without worrying about your vehicle. AAD Transport & Recovery provides accident recovery services across Birmingham, clearing your vehicle from the scene safely and taking it to a garage, insurance-approved bodyshop, or your chosen location. We work calmly and efficiently, understanding this is a difficult moment for you.

For straightforward local moves, wheel-lift recovery is a fast and efficient option. We lift the front or rear wheels off the ground and tow the vehicle safely — ideal for short-distance recovery to a nearby garage or home address.

Broken down miles from home? Bought a car from another city? AAD Transport & Recovery offers long-distance recovery across the UK, not just within Birmingham. We handle the logistics so you don't have to worry about how your vehicle gets back safely, with clear pricing agreed before we set off.

Larger vehicles need specialist equipment and experience. Our heavy-duty recovery service covers vans, light trucks and larger commercial vehicles across Birmingham, handled by a team trained to move bigger loads safely and legally.

Bikes need different handling to cars. Our motorcycle recovery service uses secure tie-down transport designed specifically for two wheels, so your motorbike is protected whether you've broken down, had an accident, or need it moved to a garage.

Caravans, motorhomes and trailers present their own recovery challenges due to size and weight. We provide RV and trailer recovery across Birmingham and further afield, helping you get back on the road or safely to your destination.

link.custom_attributes: aria-label|Learn more about RV & Trailer Recovery

settings.editor: Downtime costs businesses money. Our commercial vehicle towing service is built for fleet operators, tradespeople and delivery businesses who need vans and light commercial vehicles recovered quickly and professionally, with minimal disruption.

link.custom_attributes: aria-label|Learn more about Commercial Vehicle Towing

settings.editor: Flat battery? We provide jump-start and battery boost services across Birmingham, diagnosing whether a jump start will get you going or whether the vehicle needs further attention.

A flat tyre shouldn't ruin your day. We offer flat tyre assistance, tyre changes, spare tyre installation and puncture repair support at the roadside, getting you moving again quickly wherever it's safe to do so.

link.custom_attributes: aria-label|Learn more about Tyre & Flat Tyre Services

settings.editor: Run out of fuel on the road? We offer emergency fuel delivery so you're not left stranded, bringing enough fuel to reach the nearest station safely.

Not every job is an emergency. We also provide planned vehicle transport services — inter-city relocation, dealership deliveries, auction vehicle collection, and careful transport for luxury and classic cars that need extra attention.

link.custom_attributes: aria-label|Learn more about Car Lockout Service

settings.editor: Beyond the specifics above, our general roadside assistance covers car lockouts, winch-outs for vehicles stuck in mud, snow, or ditches, and recovery from impound lots. Whatever situation you find yourself in, get in touch, and we'll advise the best solution.

Not every job is an emergency. We also provide planned vehicle transport services — inter-city relocation, dealership deliveries, auction vehicle collection, and careful transport for luxury and classic cars that need extra attention.
Tell us what's happened and we'll advise the safest, most suitable recovery option — day or night.
COMMON CALL-OUTS

settings.title: Common Reasons Drivers Call Us For Recovery

settings.editor: No two breakdowns are the same, but most fall into a handful of familiar categories. Here are the situations we help with most often across Birmingham:
If you're not sure exactly what's wrong, that's fine — call us, describe what's happening, and we'll talk you through whether it's safe to continue or whether recovery is the better option.

• Car won't start at home, at work, in a car park or at the roadside
  • Flat battery, failed jump start or electrical fault
  • Flat tyre, damaged wheel or tyre blowout
  • Warning lights, limp mode or sudden loss of power
  • Overheating, coolant leaks or unusual engine noises
  • Clutch, gearbox or other mechanical faults

• Running out of fuel or misfuelling
  • Vehicle involved in a collision and needs recovering from the scene
  • Van or commercial vehicle breakdown affecting a working day
  • Non-running vehicle that needs moving to a garage
  • Vehicle stuck after a motorway or major road fault
  • Locked out of your own car
WHY US
Choosing the right recovery company matters when your vehicle is off the road and you need someone you can trust to sort it out properly.

tabs.tab_title: Do you offer 24/7 breakdown recovery in Birmingham?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. AAD Transport & Recovery operates 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, across Birmingham and the surrounding areas, including emergency breakdowns at any time of day or night.

tabs.tab_title: How quickly can you get to me?
tabs.tab_content: Response times depend on your location and current job volume, but we prioritise getting to you as quickly as possible, especially in unsafe roadside situations. Call us directly for the fastest response.

tabs.tab_title: Do you tow cars long distances, or just locally?
tabs.tab_content: Both. We handle local towing within Birmingham as well as long-distance recovery anywhere in the UK.

tabs.tab_title: What's the difference between flatbed and wheel-lift recovery?
tabs.tab_content: Flatbed recovery loads the whole vehicle onto a platform, ideal for damaged, low-clearance or non-running vehicles. Wheel-lift recovery tows the vehicle with its wheels partially off the ground and is typically used for quicker, shorter-distance jobs.

tabs.tab_title: Can you recover my vehicle after an accident?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. We provide accident recovery, clearing your vehicle from the scene safely and transporting it to a garage, body shop, or your preferred location.

tabs.tab_title: Do you recover vans and commercial vehicles?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. We offer commercial vehicle towing and heavy-duty recovery for vans and light commercial vehicles.

tabs.tab_title: Can you help with motorbikes, caravans or trailers?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. We provide dedicated motorcycle recovery as well as RV and trailer recovery for caravans, motorhomes and trailers.

tabs.tab_title: What if I just have a flat tyre or flat battery?
tabs.tab_content: We offer flat tyre assistance, spare tyre fitting, and battery jump-start services. Many of these issues can be resolved at the roadside without needing a full tow.

tabs.tab_title: Do you deliver fuel if I've run out?
tabs.tab_content: Yes, we provide emergency fuel delivery to get you moving again.

tabs.tab_title: Can I choose the garage my car is taken to?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. If your vehicle needs recovering, it can usually be taken to your garage of choice, a repair centre, your home address, or another safe destination you specify.

tabs.tab_title: How much does breakdown recovery in Birmingham cost?
tabs.tab_content: Pricing depends on the type of recovery, distance, and vehicle involved. Call us for a free, no-obligation quote before we begin any work.

tabs.tab_title: What areas do you cover?

html{scroll-behavior:smooth}body{background:#fff}
.x-root{--padding-top:0;--padding-bottom:0;font-family:"Figtree",sans-serif;color:var(--x-text);overflow-x:clip}
.x-root .e-con{--padding-left:0;--padding-right:0}

.x-h .elementor-heading-title{font-family:"Outfit",sans-serif;color:var(--x-navy);letter-spacing:-.02em}
.x-t p:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
/* reveal */
.x-js .rv{opacity:0;transform:translateY(28px);transition:opacity .8s var(--x-ease),transform .8s var(--x-ease)}
.x-js .rv.rv-left{transform:translateX(-40px)}.x-js .rv.rv-right{transform:translateX(40px)}
.x-js .rv.is-in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.rv-d1{transition-delay:.08s!important}.rv-d2{transition-delay:.16s!important}.rv-d3{transition-delay:.24s!important}
body.elementor-editor-active .rv{opacity:1!important;transform:none!important}
/* buttons */
.x-btn .elementor-button,.x-link .elementor-button{font-family:"Outfit",sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:16px;border-radius:999px;padding:16px 28px;background:var(--x-orange);color:#fff;border:2px solid var(--x-orange);box-shadow:0 12px 24px -10px rgba(254,100,2,.6);transition:transform .25s var(--x-ease),box-shadow .25s,background .25s,color .25s}
.x-btn .elementor-button:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);background:var(--x-orange-2);border-color:var(--x-orange-2);box-shadow:0 18px 30px -12px rgba(254,100,2,.7);color:#fff}
.x-btn-sm .elementor-button{padding:12px 22px;font-size:15px}
.x-btn-ghost .elementor-button{background:transparent;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);box-shadow:none;color:#fff}
.x-btn-ghost .elementor-button:hover{background:#fff;color:var(--x-navy);border-color:#fff}
.x-btn-white .elementor-button{background:#fff;color:var(--x-orange);border-color:#fff}
.x-btn-white .elementor-button:hover{background:var(--x-navy);border-color:var(--x-navy);color:#fff}
.x-btn-pulse .elementor-button{animation:xpulse 2.4s infinite}
@keyframes xpulse{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(254,100,2,.55)}70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 16px rgba(254,100,2,0)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(254,100,2,0)}}
.x-link .elementor-button{background:none;border:0;box-shadow:none;padding:0;color:var(--x-orange);font-size:15px}
.x-link .elementor-button:after{content:"→";margin-left:8px;display:inline-block;transition:transform .25s}
.x-link .elementor-button:hover:after{transform:translateX(5px)}
.x-btnrow{gap:14px}
/* header */
.x-header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:999;transition:box-shadow .3s}
.x-topbar{background:var(--x-navy-2);padding:8px 0;font-size:14px}
.x-topbar .elementor-icon-list-text{color:#C9D3EC;font-weight:500}
.x-topbar .x-topphone .elementor-icon-list-text{color:#fff;font-weight:600}
.x-topbar i{color:var(--x-orange)!important}
.x-live i{font-size:8px!important;animation:xblink 1.6s infinite}
@keyframes xblink{50%{opacity:.25}}
.x-mainbar{background:rgba(255,255,255,.92);backdrop-filter:saturate(1.6) blur(14px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:saturate(1.6) blur(14px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--x-line);transition:padding .3s}
.x-mainbar>.e-con-inner{padding-top:14px!important;padding-bottom:14px!important;transition:padding .3s;gap:20px}
.x-header.is-scrolled{box-shadow:var(--x-sh)}

.x-logo img{max-width:150px;transition:max-width .3s}.x-header.is-scrolled .x-logo img{max-width:120px}
.x-nav{flex:1}.x-nav .elementor-nav-menu--main .elementor-item{font-family:"Figtree";font-weight:600;font-size:15px;padding:10px 16px}

.x-nav .elementor-nav-menu--main .sub-menu{animation:xdrop .25s var(--x-ease)}
@keyframes xdrop{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px)}}
.x-nav .elementor-nav-menu--dropdown a{font-weight:500;padding:12px 20px!important}
/* hero */
.x-hero{position:relative;padding:110px 0 130px!important;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate}

.x-hero:after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-180px;top:-180px;width:520px;height:520px;border-radius:50%;z-index:-1;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(254,100,2,.35),transparent 65%);animation:xfloat 9s ease-in-out infinite}

.x-hero>.e-con-inner{gap:56px;align-items:center}
.x-hero-copy{flex:1 1 56%;gap:22px}
.x-badge p{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);color:#fff;border-radius:999px;padding:8px 16px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.02em;margin:0}

.x-hero-title .elementor-heading-title{color:#fff;font-size:clamp(34px,4.4vw,58px);font-weight:800;line-height:1.08}

.x-form textarea{min-height:96px}
.x-form .elementor-button{width:100%;border-radius:999px;background:var(--x-orange)!important;font-family:"Outfit";font-weight:700;font-size:16px;padding:16px;transition:transform .25s,background .25s}
.x-form .elementor-button:hover{background:var(--x-orange-2)!important;transform:translateY(-2px)}

.x-sec{padding:100px 0!important}.x-sec>.e-con-inner{gap:18px}
.x-eyebrow p{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-family:"Outfit";font-weight:700;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--x-orange);margin:0}

.x-sec-split{padding:80px 0!important}
.x-split{gap:64px;align-items:center}.x-split-rev{flex-direction:row-reverse!important}
.x-split>.e-con{flex:1 1 50%}
.x-media-wrap{position:relative}

.x-grid{gap:26px;width:100%;margin-top:20px}

.x-scard{background:#fff;border-radius:var(--x-r);overflow:hidden;text-align:left;box-shadow:0 2px 0 var(--x-line);transition:transform .45s var(--x-ease),box-shadow .45s}

.x-areas{gap:10px;margin-top:6px}
.x-area .elementor-heading-title{font-family:"Figtree"!important;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;background:var(--x-light);border:1px solid var(--x-line);color:var(--x-navy);border-radius:999px;padding:9px 16px 9px 34px;position:relative;transition:all .25s;letter-spacing:0}
.x-area .elementor-heading-title:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:15px;top:50%;width:8px;height:8px;margin-top:-4px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--x-orange)}

.x-map iframe{border-radius:24px;height:460px!important;box-shadow:var(--x-sh-lg);filter:saturate(.9)}

.x-faq .elementor-tab-title.elementor-active{background:var(--x-navy)}
.x-faq .elementor-tab-title.elementor-active a,.x-faq .elementor-tab-title.elementor-active .elementor-accordion-icon{color:#fff!important}
.x-faq .elementor-accordion-icon{color:var(--x-orange)!important}
.x-faq .elementor-tab-content{padding:20px 24px!important;border:0!important;line-height:1.75;font-size:15.5px}
.x-sec-cta{padding-top:0!important}
.x-cta{background:linear-gradient(120deg,var(--x-orange),#FF8A33);border-radius:28px;padding:56px 60px!important;gap:30px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;position:relative;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 30px 60px -25px rgba(254,100,2,.6)}
.x-cta:after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-100px;bottom:-140px;width:360px;height:360px;border-radius:50%;border:50px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12)}

.x-fhead .elementor-heading-title{color:#fff;font-family:"Outfit";font-weight:700;font-size:16px;letter-spacing:.04em}
.x-flinks .elementor-icon-list-item{padding:6px 0!important}
.x-flinks .elementor-icon-list-text{color:#8C99BF;font-size:15px;transition:color .2s,padding .2s}
.x-flinks a:hover .elementor-icon-list-text{color:var(--x-orange);padding-left:6px}

}

settings.editor: AT A GLANCE

AAD Transport & Recovery provides 24/7 breakdown recovery in Birmingham, including emergency breakdown recovery, car recovery, accident recovery, flatbed and wheel-lift towing, and long-distance vehicle transport. Whatever's happened to your vehicle, call 07771 004242 for fast, professional roadside assistance anywhere in Birmingham and the West Midlands.

A breakdown never happens at a convenient time. Whether your car has cut out on the motorway during rush hour, refused to start outside your house on a Sunday morning, or left you stranded in a supermarket car park late at night, AAD Transport & Recovery is available around the clock to help.

Our team responds quickly, communicates clearly, and handles every vehicle with care from the moment we arrive to the moment it's safely delivered to its destination.

We cover breakdowns anywhere in Birmingham, including residential streets, workplaces, retail car parks, and busy routes such as the M6, M5, M42 and A38. If you're unsure whether your car is safe to continue driving, call us and we'll advise the safest next step.

settings.title: Car Recovery Birmingham You Can Rely On

settings.editor:
When you search for car recovery in Birmingham, you want a company that turns up quickly, treats your vehicle properly, and doesn't leave you guessing about cost or timing. AAD Transport & Recovery has built its reputation on exactly that.

We use the right vehicle for the job every time: wheel-lift recovery for quick, local jobs, and flatbed recovery for vehicles that need to be transported without touching the road, such as those with steering, suspension or transmission damage.

From the first phone call, we aim to give you a clear idea of arrival time, cost, and what happens next, so you're never left standing at the roadside wondering what's going on.
WHAT WE DO

Whatever's happened to your vehicle, we provide breakdown recovery and roadside assistance to match. From a flat tyre outside your house to a motorway breakdown or long-distance transport, our Birmingham team handles it all with care and professionalism.

AAD Transport & Recovery offers 24/7 emergency breakdown recovery across Birmingham, responding quickly whether your engine's cut out, your car won't start, or a warning light has you worried. We cover residential streets, workplaces, car parks, and major roads like the M6, M5, M42 and A38 — just call with your location and we'll be on our way.

link.custom_attributes: aria-label|Learn more about Emergency Breakdown Recovery

settings.editor: Need a vehicle towed across Birmingham? Our towing service handles cars, vans and small commercial vehicles, moving them safely to a garage, your home, or wherever you need. We use the right equipment for the job — wheel-lift for quick local jobs, flatbed for vehicles that shouldn't be dragged — so your car arrives in the same condition it left in.

Flatbed recovery is the safest way to move a vehicle that can't or shouldn't be driven whether it's a low-clearance car, a vehicle with steering or transmission damage, or one that's been in an accident. We load, secure, and transport your car without it touching the ground, avoiding further damage on the journey.

Being involved in an accident is stressful enough without worrying about your vehicle. AAD Transport & Recovery provides accident recovery services across Birmingham, clearing your vehicle from the scene safely and taking it to a garage, insurance-approved bodyshop, or your chosen location. We work calmly and efficiently, understanding this is a difficult moment for you.

For straightforward local moves, wheel-lift recovery is a fast and efficient option. We lift the front or rear wheels off the ground and tow the vehicle safely — ideal for short-distance recovery to a nearby garage or home address.

Broken down miles from home? Bought a car from another city? AAD Transport & Recovery offers long-distance recovery across the UK, not just within Birmingham. We handle the logistics so you don't have to worry about how your vehicle gets back safely, with clear pricing agreed before we set off.

Larger vehicles need specialist equipment and experience. Our heavy-duty recovery service covers vans, light trucks and larger commercial vehicles across Birmingham, handled by a team trained to move bigger loads safely and legally.

Bikes need different handling to cars. Our motorcycle recovery service uses secure tie-down transport designed specifically for two wheels, so your motorbike is protected whether you've broken down, had an accident, or need it moved to a garage.

Caravans, motorhomes and trailers present their own recovery challenges due to size and weight. We provide RV and trailer recovery across Birmingham and further afield, helping you get back on the road or safely to your destination.

tabs.tab_title: Do you offer 24/7 breakdown recovery in Birmingham?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. AAD Transport & Recovery operates 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, across Birmingham and the surrounding areas, including emergency breakdowns at any time of day or night.

tabs.tab_title: How quickly can you get to me?
tabs.tab_content: Response times depend on your location and current job volume, but we prioritise getting to you as quickly as possible, especially in unsafe roadside situations. Call us directly for the fastest response.

tabs.tab_title: Do you tow cars long distances, or just locally?
tabs.tab_content: Both. We handle local towing within Birmingham as well as long-distance recovery anywhere in the UK.

tabs.tab_title: What's the difference between flatbed and wheel-lift recovery?
tabs.tab_content: Flatbed recovery loads the whole vehicle onto a platform, ideal for damaged, low-clearance or non-running vehicles. Wheel-lift recovery tows the vehicle with its wheels partially off the ground and is typically used for quicker, shorter-distance jobs.

tabs.tab_title: Can you recover my vehicle after an accident?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. We provide accident recovery, clearing your vehicle from the scene safely and transporting it to a garage, body shop, or your preferred location.

tabs.tab_title: Do you recover vans and commercial vehicles?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. We offer commercial vehicle towing and heavy-duty recovery for vans and light commercial vehicles.

tabs.tab_title: Can you help with motorbikes, caravans or trailers?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. We provide dedicated motorcycle recovery as well as RV and trailer recovery for caravans, motorhomes and trailers.

tabs.tab_title: What if I just have a flat tyre or flat battery?
tabs.tab_content: We offer flat tyre assistance, spare tyre fitting, and battery jump-start services. Many of these issues can be resolved at the roadside without needing a full tow.

tabs.tab_title: Do you deliver fuel if I've run out?
tabs.tab_content: Yes, we provide emergency fuel delivery to get you moving again.

tabs.tab_title: Can I choose the garage my car is taken to?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. If your vehicle needs recovering, it can usually be taken to your garage of choice, a repair centre, your home address, or another safe destination you specify.

tabs.tab_title: How much does breakdown recovery in Birmingham cost?
tabs.tab_content: Pricing depends on the type of recovery, distance, and vehicle involved. Call us for a free, no-obligation quote before we begin any work.

tabs.tab_title: What areas do you cover?
tabs.tab_content: We cover Birmingham and the surrounding West Midlands area for local recovery, with long-distance and nationwide transport also available.
